name: Drift Series 1
editorial_article: "DRIFT Series 1" is an expansive, multi-disciplinary project by the pioneering British electronic duo Underworld, documenting a highly ambitious year-long creative challenge. Initiated in November 2018, the "Drift" project saw Rick Smith and Karl Hyde committing to the creation and release of new music, video, and visual content on a weekly basis for 52 consecutive weeks. This process was intentionally designed to disrupt the traditional album-and-tour cycle, allowing the duo to experiment with spontaneity, improvisation, and a wide array of sonic textures that might not have fit into a tightly curated studio album.\n\nThe resulting collection, "DRIFT Series 1," serves as the definitive compilation of this creative marathon. Spanning nearly six hours of audio across multiple discs, the project is a sprawling mosaic of Underworld’s multifaceted identity. It traverses ambient soundscapes, pulsing techno, experimental drone, and their signature spoken-word storytelling. By stripping away the constraints of standard release schedules, Underworld explored an unfiltered, raw form of expression, inviting listeners into a transparent view of their artistic process. The release eventually culminated in a "Complete" edition, solidifying a pivotal era in their career defined by a relentless drive to evolve. It remains a landmark entry in the duo’s discography for its scale, its defiance of industry norms, and its intimate look at how a long-standing group continues to reinvent their own boundaries.
editorial_pitch: A sprawling, ambitious 52-week creative marathon from Underworld, released as a massive multi-disc compilation that documents their experimentation with ambient, techno, and experimental textures.
